zh: 模型方案新增「校验 HTTPS 证书」开关，默认不校验，内网自签证书的模型网关可以直接连通；接公网网关时可勾选严格校验。证书校验失败时，测试连接会提示取消勾选或配置受信任根证书。
en: Model profiles now have a "Verify HTTPS certificate" switch, off by default so internal gateways with self-signed certificates connect out of the box; tick it for strict checking on public gateways. Certificate failures in the connection test now suggest unticking it or installing a trusted root certificate.
